title: A Few Things
content: Mall World sounds like Upload... like we're uploaded to Mall World in the "Cloud" and depending on where we are in status in the dream realm, that's basically what we see... So the bathrooms, our minds usually see them as places where dirty things happen... So that's why most of us see them dirty, and the public bathroom is the worst place to have privacy... but, those who see the bathroom as a place to get clean, that's what they see in their realm of the Cloud they're uploaded to... and that's why most people see dirty public restrooms, and some people see them clean... at least that's my partial hypothesis.... I like to reference the viewpoint analogy... when you see a pyramid from only one side, all you see is a triangle... you have to see it from the top to see all dimensions of the pyramid... that's just my two cents... let me go to sleep before the cat cries all night lol... Goodnight everybody 💛 🌹 💤 😴
